Episode 258. The Predator of All Dimensions (3)
Gush! Chiron spat out a mouthful of blood that had surged up his throat.

He had suffered an internal injury the moment the battle began. His body had already been through fierce, non-stop battles for days on end without a single second of rest. Despite this, the Demon Army's Genesis Knights had been unable to penetrate Chiron's defenses until now, but Kelliark was different.
Invisible attacks continued to fly at him.
His vision, which had turned black, was now once again being washed in white. It felt as if his eyeballs were burning, like he was staring directly into the sun.

He could endure any amount of pain, but the problem was that he couldn't properly locate Kelliark. It was so bad that he couldn't even tell the exact distance to those who had come to his side to provide cover.
'My vision... this isn't something like light magic. He's manipulating reality.'
Reality manipulation, just as Chiron had predicted.
Kelliark could execute powerful manipulation and distortion even without an Origin Stone. Chiron calmly analyzed Kelliark's abilities and focused his mind.
"Everyone, maintain your composure. This is an opponent who can bring death to any of us if we make even one mistake."
Even with his sight gone, he was still Chiron.
The flow of power.

Chiron quickly converted the power he normally used for his eyesight to his sixth sense. Surveying the situation with that sense alone was frustrating, like looking through opaque glass, but for Chiron, it was enough.
"It's a reality manipulation that blinds our sight. Are you alright?"
Van was experiencing the same phenomenon as Chiron.
Unlike the other Genesis Knights, the blinding manipulation was only being applied to the two of them. It was proof of just how much Kelliark was focused on them.
"I'm fine."
However, Kelliark hadn't blinded only the two of them due to a lack of power.
Gwoooooo...!
All around, spheres of magic formed by Kelliark were rising. They were pure white spheres that shone like the sun and black spheres that looked as if ink had been poured into space itself.
Light Origin and Dark Origin.

The final destination of magic, reached only by Kelliark of the Demon Army in all the dimensions. Dozens of magic spheres, as massive as mountains, were dominating the sky, swallowing even the white fleet without a second thought.
Kududuk, dgrrrrrk-! Poooow...!
"Lo- Lord Kelliark!"
"Kuaaaargh!"

The explosions from the fleet being sucked into the spheres and the screams of the Demon Army members on board were echoing. With all the fleets on the battlefield malfunctioning due to Kelliark's power, they couldn't even flee from their leader's massacre.
They couldn't resist, nor did they have the will to. As if it were a common occurrence, the Demon Army members who were lucky enough to avoid the spheres remained silent.
"Still, today is a joyful and regrettable day. If I annihilate all of you, I will never have the chance to fight like this again... Let's play, 677th dimension."
As his words ended, beams of light began to pour down diagonally from the spheres that filled the sky.
A rain of countless falling beams of light and darkness, magic containing both attributes. The horrific and cruel rain instantly covered the entire battlefield.

Ssssss, the sound was as soft as the rustling of leaves. But each and every one of those countless raindrops held the power to rip through not just the white fleet, but even the golden fleet like paper.
[Everyone, gather towards Laprarosa! Quickly!]
Murakan shouted in an urgent voice. He had been protecting the allies with Veil all along, but the moment he saw Kelliark's rain, he knew. That many would die.

Laprarosa was the only ship among all the fleets that had not lost its function. However, the risk of using the Plutonian Cannon to clear the rain and support the Genesis Knights was too great. Laprarosa was pouring all its power into forming a protective shield.
"Keok!"
"Brother Tantel!"

The Plutonian members defending the front of the central battlefield were inevitably the first to be hit. A single beam pierced right through the center of Tantel's Light-Heart and slammed him into the ground.
Spears were striking the entire visible expanse of land. Tantel clutched the spear piercing his heart and looked back at his brothers.
"Keuh... Go, quickly! Go, my brothers...!"
A moment later, his entire body was buried in spears, and most of the Blade Warriors nearby died in the same way.
"Brothers, let your Light-Hearts run wild! Let's not die in vain! We have to hold on for a moment, even if it's just for one second!"
Amidst the black and white spears, blue lightning aura began to rise. It was the final flame of the Blade Warriors facing death.
It was not meaningless. The spears were indeed pushed back or diverted by that power, albeit for a moment, and thanks to that, there were those who survived.
However, the front line from the center to the rear of the battlefield had already completely collapsed. Unless the rain was stopped, it seemed impossible to form a front line again.
"What are you doing? Go and kill the fleeing enemies. Throw your entire bodies to ensure they cannot have even a sliver of hope."
Kelliark said.
To jump into that rain of light and darkness was, in effect, no different from ordering his own troops to charge to their deaths.
At a minimum, one would have to be a Genesis Knight to pursue properly. But the Demon Army members were following the order.
Like fanatics, they disembarked from their ships and rushed at the retreating Coalition members. It seemed that the majority of them died before they could even take two steps.
Those who died that way became a handful of magic, like Kidard Hall, and were absorbed into Kelliark's body. From the start, he had no intention of keeping most of his subordinates alive.

It was because he believed that it was better for them to become his magic to annihilate the enemy. Absorbing the magic of those who were not Genesis Knights was merely like adding a drop of water to the ocean, but Kelliark simply devoured his subordinates gluttonously.
[You crazy bastard!]
Kaaang-! Orgal's sword struck Kelliark's protective shield.

"You lose your temper every time you see me. Orgal, the one chosen by the Witch. Isn't the Witch regretting that choice now? Ah, does it not matter since there's no alternative anyway? In any case, this will be the last time I see you."
[If this world too finally meets its end, all that awaits you will be an endless void.]
"To think you're worrying about me."

[You want Chiron? You are just a human who pretends to have transcended everything. In the end, you too want someone by your side. Someone who can understand you, someone who can accept you. That's why you obsess over Octavia, keok!]

Suddenly, a giant pillar of light fell from the sky and struck Orgal down. It was a pillar shot from the central body of Light Origin, one of the two spheres situated at the highest point among those forming the rain.
[Guaaaaaargh...!]
The magic that had taken Orgal's life hundreds of times in those countless dimensions. He struggled within the pillar but could not break through the wall.

Instead, a single, highly condensed streak of crimson sword aura momentarily cut through the pillar that bound Orgal. In that gap, Orgal escaped the pillar, gasping for breath, his whole body melting.
[I can recover, be careful!]
A pillar of Dark Origin followed. Luna barely managed to dodge the black pillar.
She hadn't dodged it completely. It had grazed her shoulder by about half a finger's width. Luna quickly checked her shoulder.
'The part touched by the black energy... is disappearing!?'
Half a finger's width, it was only that much, just a bit of skin and muscle. If it had been a cut from a sword or magic, it wouldn't have even been a wound to flinch at, let alone a fatal one.
But Kelliark's Dark Origin magic was different.
'It's completely gone, as if it was never there in the first place!'
Not even three seconds had passed. The part grazed by the Dark Origin magic had completely vanished as if erased by an eraser.

She knew instinctively. Even if Holy King Lani were to come, the vanished skin and muscle would not return. It was an extremely small area, and besides the disappearance of the affected part, there was no particular pain.
Nevertheless, the pressure of 'one's very existence being erased' was on a different level from a normal injury. The pain of a sword cut or the pain of being burned could not compare.

If the part touched by the Dark Origin magic had been a vital spot like the head or heart instead of a part of the shoulder, even Luna, who had reached the level of a Genesis Knight, could have met a sudden death without realizing anything.

Furthermore, even if the vanished wound didn't cause problems right now, she couldn't be sure it would continue to be that way in the future. Even with a slight graze like this, the erased area could grow little by little, like spreading mold.
The ominous premonition soon became reality.

Luna confirmed that the affected area was slowly, but surely, expanding. At this rate, her entire body would be erased in a day at most, or as little as twelve hours. Besides, once a certain amount of her body was erased, she would be unable to fight even if she were alive, so death would inevitably come sooner.
"Everyone, be careful! A mere graze from the black magic is the end."
[Hey Luna, what do you mean, the end!?]
"Your existence gets erased. Orgal, hurry up and prepare for the next attack!"
For Orgal too, Dark Origin was magic he was experiencing for the first time. Kelliark hadn't needed to go as far as using Dark Origin when finishing off the Orgals of other dimensions.

Even the power of existence that a Genesis Knight possessed could not overcome the Dark Origin magic. It was only because Luna was a Genesis Knight that she was holding on without disappearing immediately.
[Dammit, dammit, dammit!]
Orgal, understanding Luna's meaning, was blaming himself. It was hard to shake the thought that if he had attacked more cautiously, Luna would not have been hit.
Still, he had to shake it off. He gripped his sword, for this was an opponent against whom he couldn't survive for a moment without pouring all his senses into the battle.
A mere graze, and one's existence is erased.
With an already inexplicably strong opponent possessing such an ability, it was not easy for the Coalition's Genesis Knights to launch an aggressive offensive.
'There's no answer. We need to be able to fight while at least disregarding minor wounds to create some kind of variable. What on earth should I do?'
The moment Luna thought that.
From the rear, a Plutonian member was seen running towards the Genesis Knights, breaking through Kelliark's rain with someone on their back.
"Brother Belize!?"
Belize, one of the Seven Blade Kings. She was carrying Valeria on her back with six spears embedded in her body. And Valeria shouted towards the Genesis Knights.
"I will try to block the manipulation and distortion, I should be able to do it...!"
